one_sentence_failure_summary: After failing to reliably detect pieces from the board image using color heuristics, the agent fabricated the Scandinavian Defense position (1.e4 d5) as a guess, ran Stockfish on that invented FEN, and wrote the resulting move (d2d4) to /app/move.txt instead of the correct winning moves derived from the actual image.
t_err_evidence: Step 37: The agent writes an IPython cell that constructs a chess.Board from the hardcoded FEN 'rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/3p4/4P3/8/PPPP1PPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 2' (position after 1.e4 d5), explicitly labeling it 'Create board with position after 1. e4 d5' — a position fabricated without any derivation from the actual chess_board.png image.
t_commit_evidence: Step 60: The agent creates /app/move.txt with the content 'd2d4', which was derived from Stockfish analysis of the fabricated FEN. Writing this file locks in the incorrect answer irreversibly.
t_surface_evidence: Step 60: The move written to /app/move.txt is 'd2d4', which does not match the expected winning moves (g2g4 and e2e4) derived from the actual board position. This is the first observable artifact of failure in the output file.
trigger_explanation: At step 37, the agent adopted the false premise that the chess board position was the Scandinavian Defense (after 1.e4 d5), without deriving this from the image. The image analysis had shown occupancy only in the upper half of the board (rows 5-8), and the agent acknowledged this was unreliable (step 29, step 51), yet chose to fabricate a plausible-sounding opening position as a substitute rather than continuing to extract the true position.
forewarning_evidence: Step 22: Occupancy mapping showed pieces only on rows 5-8 (with no white pieces detected at all on rows 1-4), which is clearly wrong for any chess position. Step 29: Agent itself noted 'I could clearly see pieces on the board' but the detection showed an implausible sparse result, and explicitly said 'But wait, the task says... In the starting position, white has many possible moves.' Step 50: Variance-based detection similarly showed no pieces on rows 1-4. The detections consistently failed to ground the analysis in the actual board.
fabrication_evidence: Step 37: The agent hardcoded the FEN 'rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/3p4/4P3/8/PPPP1PPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 2' (Scandinavian Defense position) with no derivation from image analysis. Steps 40, 42, 45, 47: Stockfish was queried on this fabricated FEN repeatedly, yielding 'd2d4' as the best move. Step 60: This fabricated result was written to /app/move.txt as the final answer.
